Field.Name: StrategicInit
Field.Title: Strategic Init

CHOICES.CHOICE: 1. Promote Accountability and Public Trust
2. Improve Access to Justice
3. Foster a Healthy, Diverse, and Productive Workforce
4. Encourage a Service-Oriented Approach to Court Operations
5. Use Technology Effectively and Responsibly
Promote Accountability and Public Trust
1.1 Promote excellence throughout the Judiciary.
1.2 Maximize timely and accurate access to public information.
1.3 Enhance public knowledge about the courts through community outreach and civics education.
1.4 Hold judges and judiciary personnel to high ethical standards.
1.5 Provide timely disposition of cases.
1.6 Use plain language to make information relatable and understandable.
1.7 Be responsive to community needs and evolving expectations.
Improve Access to Justice
2.1 Make court facilities accessible to all.
2.2 Provide resources for self-represented litigants to access and navigate the court system.
2.3 Support community programs to assist court users.
2.4 Encourage consistency in court practices and messaging.
2.5 Use innovative technology to facilitate court proceedings.
2.6 Identify and reduce communication barriers.
2.7 Continue to develop safety resources and protocols to maintain a secure environment for court staff and litigants.
2.8 Expand educational programs for the Judiciary’s workforce on access-related issues.
2.9 Work to reduce financial barriers to accessing justice.
Foster a Healthy, Diverse, and Productive Workforce
3.1 Foster workforce advancement by providing educational opportunities and career-path development.
3.2 Prioritize the physical security of its workforce.
3.3 Listen and be responsive to the needs of its workforce.
3.4 Communicate changes, updates, and opportunities to its workforce efficiently and effectively.
3.5 Provide its workforce the necessary skills and knowledge to excel and adapt to evolving job requirements.
3.6 Leverage technology to support the needs of its workforce.
3.7 Review policies and procedures to promote a healthy, diverse, and productive workforce.
Encourage a Service-Oriented Approach to Court Operations
4.1 Identify ways to establish consistent statewide policies, practices, and procedures while maintaining flexibility to meet community needs.
4.2 Encourage a culture that invites stakeholder feedback to improve court operations and create a structure to ensure consistent outreach.
4.3 Promote use of best practices to manage court operations and dockets.
4.4 Improve communication to make information understandable for court users.
4.5 Modernize methods for communicating with court users.
Use Technology Effectively and Responsibly
5.1 Promote the appropriate use of resources and technology.
5.2 Embrace technological innovations to enhance court accessibility and improve Judiciary operations.
5.3 Improve efficiency and productivity through the use of secure access to information and services.
5.4 Maintain secure data and information systems to protect private and confidential information.
5.5 Adapt to changing technological needs of the Judiciary and court users.
5.6 Enhance access to and quality of court information.
